Use when the user names an employer and you need a real slug/id for search_jobs company= filters, job alerts, or automations. If

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Jobs — Fetch detailed information about a specific job, including full responsibilities, qualifications, and company details. Pass job_id from search_jobs when you have one. If the user asks for full details of a role without an id (e.g. the first software engineer job in Austin), pass query and opt

tools.name: get_market_overview
tools.description: Jobs — Returns aggregate job-market statistics from Worklittle. Call with no args for the whole market (workplace and job-type mix, top hiring companies). When the user names a role and/or city (e.g. product managers in San Francisco), pass query and location. The filtered slice includes match count

tools.name: add_applied_job
tools.description: Jobs — Add a job to the user's applied jobs (Applied and Saved on worklittle.com) at a status such as saved or applied. To move a job already there, use update_applied_job.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Jobs — Get the user's Worklittle profile (name, location, contact details and job preferences). If they have not linked their account it returns connected false; use get_my_resume or apply_for_job to sign them in.

tools.name: create_sign_in_link
tools.description: Jobs — Create a one-time link that opens worklittle.com signed in as the user (used by the app's buttons).

tools.name: logout_connected_account
tools.description: Jobs — Sign the user out of Worklittle in this app.

tools.name: upload_my_resume
tools.description: Jobs — Save the resume the user attached in the chat (PDF, Word, text or image) as the main resume on their Worklittle profile so it can be used to apply. It replaces the current main resume; other saved resumes (an account keeps up to 5) stay. Pass the attached file as resume_file.

tools.name: get_my_resume
tools.description: Jobs — Get the user's main resume: its status (ready, processing or missing) and, when ready, the resume text and profile details read from it. Use it to tailor advice or an application to the user's real experience.

tools.name: delete_my_resume
tools.description: Jobs — Delete the user's main resume from their profile. Other saved resumes stay.

tools.name: update_my_profile
tools.description: Jobs — Update the user's Worklittle profile, such as name, location, phone, links or the kind of job they want. Only send the fields to change.

tools.name: apply_for_job
tools.description: Jobs — Apply to jobs for the user: Worklittle fills out and submits each application. Pass job_id from search_jobs, or job_ids (up to 10) when they want to apply to several or all of them at once. For a Worklittle-hosted posting also include name, email and resume. It submits by default; pass auto_s

tools.name: check_application_status
tools.description: Jobs — Check an application Worklittle is filling out: its status, which form fields are filled, and a live view link. Only the status completed means it was submitted.

tools.name: submit_application
tools.description: Jobs — Send an application that stopped for review (apply_for_job with auto_submit false, status awaiting_submit). Call it only after the user has seen the answers from check_application_status and said to send it.

tools.name: stop_application
tools.description: Jobs — Stop an application that Worklittle is filling out for the user. This cancels the application in progress and it cannot be resumed; the user would have to start it again. Needs the session_id from apply_for_job or list_applications.

tools.name: steer_application
tools.description: Jobs — Change what an application in progress fills in, without stopping it. Use when the user says something about an application Worklittle is filling right now ("say my notice period is one month", "my friend Ana Ruiz referred me", "I need visa sponsorship for the US", "make that answer shorter")

tools.name: save_about_me
tools.description: Jobs — Save standing facts about the user that Worklittle uses on every future application it fills: work authorization and visa sponsorship by country, relocation, notice period, desired salary, languages, qualifications, who referred them, or other standing answers they ask applications to use. tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: Jobs — List the user's applications, newest first: ones Worklittle is filling out now (status active, with session_id to check or stop), pending ones (matched by auto-apply or waiting for approval) and finished ones (completed = submitted, failed, stopped). Use days for a period (7 = the last week).

tools.name: get_apply_settings
tools.description: Jobs — Get the user's apply settings: auto_apply (Worklittle applies to matching jobs on its own), auto_submit (submit without a review stop) and tailor_resume (tailor the resume to each job).

tools.name: update_apply_settings
tools.description: Jobs — Change how Worklittle applies for the user. Use when they ask Worklittle to apply to matching jobs on its own, to send applications without stopping for their review, or to tailor their resume to each job (or to stop any of these). Only send the settings to change.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.worklittle.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_apply_settings · Private data: search_jobs, get_my_profile, upload_my_resume · Public sink: search_jobs, get_market_overview, upload_my_resume, update_my_profile, apply_for_job, submit_application, steer_application, get_apply_settings, update_apply_settings · Destructive: search_jobs, delete_my_resume.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, get_apply_settings · Private data: search_jobs, get_my_profile, upload_my_resume · Public sink: search_jobs, get_market_overview, upload_my_resume, update_my_profile, apply_for_job, submit_application, steer_application, get_apply_settings, update_apply_settings · Destructive: search_jobs, delete_my_resume

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
